---
title: "Genomic Inflation Assessment"
subtitle: "QQ Plots and Lambda for EWAS Results"
---

## Overview

This document assesses genomic inflation in the EWAS results by calculating the genomic inflation factor (lambda) and generating quantile-quantile (QQ) plots for each dementia transition category. If lambda exceeds 1.1 for any category, bacon correction is applied.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages

pacman::p_load(patchwork, scales, bacon, install = FALSE)
conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load Data

Read the genome-wide association results (799,149 CpG sites) in wide format.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

asso_wide <- read_rds(
  here("data/upon_request/whole_genome_wide.rds")
)

glimpse(asso_wide)
```

## Prepare Long-Format P-Values

Pivot the wide data to long format and convert -log10(p-values) back to p-values.

```{r}
#| label: pivot-long

demcat_labels <- c(
  "stable_mci"   = "Stable MCI",
  "normal2mci"   = "Normal to MCI",
  "normal2incid" = "Normal to Incident Dementia",
  "mci2incid"    = "MCI to Incident Dementia",
  "prev"         = "Prevalent Dementia"
)

asso_pval <- asso_wide |>
  select(cg, starts_with("nlog10_p_value_")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("nlog10_p_value_"),
    names_to = "demcat",
    names_prefix = "nlog10_p_value_",
    values_to = "nlog10_p_value"
  )

asso_est <- asso_wide |>
  select(cg, starts_with("estimate_")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("estimate_"),
    names_to = "demcat",
    names_prefix = "estimate_",
    values_to = "estimate"
  )

asso_long <- asso_pval |>
  left_join(asso_est, by = c("cg", "demcat")) |>
  mutate(
    p_value = 10^(-nlog10_p_value),
    demcat = factor(demcat, levels = names(demcat_labels), labels = demcat_labels)
  )

glimpse(asso_long)
```

## Calculate Genomic Inflation Factor (Lambda)

Lambda is calculated as the ratio of the median observed chi-squared statistic to the expected median under the null (0.4549364 for df = 1).

```{r}
#| label: calculate-lambda

expected_median <- qchisq(0.5, df = 1)

lambda_tbl <- asso_long |>
  mutate(chisq = qchisq(1 - p_value, df = 1)) |>
  summarise(
    n_sites = n(),
    median_chisq = median(chisq, na.rm = TRUE),
    lambda = median_chisq / expected_median,
    .by = demcat
  )

lambda_tbl
```

## QQ Plots

Generate QQ plots showing expected vs observed -log10(p-values) for each dementia category, annotated with the lambda value.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-qq-data

qq_data <- asso_long |>
  arrange(p_value, .by = demcat) |>
  mutate(
    expected = -log10(ppoints(n())),
    observed = nlog10_p_value,
    .by = demcat
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-qq-plots
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Quantile-quantile plots of EWAS p-values for each dementia transition category. The diagonal line represents the expected distribution under the null hypothesis. Lambda values are annotated in each panel."

# Create annotation labels with lambda values
lambda_labels <- lambda_tbl |>
  mutate(label = glue("lambda == {round(lambda, 3)}"))

qq_plot <- qq_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5, color = "#276FBF") +
  geom_text(
    data = lambda_labels,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
    parse = TRUE,
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
    size = 4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~demcat, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = expression(Expected ~ -log[10](italic(p))),
    y = expression(Observed ~ -log[10](italic(p)))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(qq_plot)
```

## Bacon Correction (If Needed)

Apply bacon correction if any category has lambda > 1.1.

```{r}
#| label: bacon-correction

needs_bacon <- any(lambda_tbl$lambda > 1.1)
cat("Any lambda > 1.1:", needs_bacon, "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: apply-bacon
#| eval: !expr needs_bacon

# Apply bacon correction per dementia category
bacon_results <- asso_long |>
  # Reconstruct z-scores: sign from estimate, magnitude from p-value
  mutate(z_score = sign(estimate) * qnorm(p_value / 2, lower.tail = FALSE)) |>
  nest(.by = demcat) |>
  mutate(
    bacon_obj = map(data, \(df) bacon(teststatistics = as.matrix(df$z_score))),
    bacon_p = map(bacon_obj, \(b) pval(b)[, 1]),
    inflation = map_dbl(bacon_obj, inflation),
    bias = map_dbl(bacon_obj, bias)
  )

# Corrected lambda values
bacon_lambda <- bacon_results |>
  mutate(
    corrected_p = bacon_p,
    corrected_chisq_median = map_dbl(corrected_p, \(p) median(qchisq(1 - p, df = 1), na.rm = TRUE)),
    lambda_corrected = corrected_chisq_median / expected_median
  ) |>
  select(demcat, inflation, bias, lambda_corrected)

# Compare uncorrected and corrected lambda
lambda_comparison <- lambda_tbl |>
  select(demcat, lambda_uncorrected = lambda) |>
  left_join(bacon_lambda, by = "demcat")

lambda_comparison
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-qq-bacon
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Quantile-quantile plots after bacon correction for bias and inflation in EWAS test statistics."
#| eval: !expr needs_bacon

# Build corrected QQ data
bacon_qq_data <- bacon_results |>
  select(demcat, data, bacon_p) |>
  unnest(cols = c(data, bacon_p)) |>
  rename(corrected_p = bacon_p) |>
  mutate(corrected_nlog10_p = -log10(corrected_p)) |>
  arrange(corrected_p, .by = demcat) |>
  mutate(
    expected = -log10(ppoints(n())),
    observed = corrected_nlog10_p,
    .by = demcat
  )

bacon_lambda_labels <- lambda_comparison |>
  mutate(label = glue("lambda == {round(lambda_corrected, 3)}"))

bacon_qq_plot <- bacon_qq_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5, color = "#276FBF") +
  geom_text(
    data = bacon_lambda_labels,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
    parse = TRUE,
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
    size = 4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~demcat, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = expression(Expected ~ -log[10](italic(p))),
    y = expression(Observed ~ -log[10](italic(p)))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(bacon_qq_plot)
```

## Save Outputs

```{r}
#| label: save-outputs

fs::dir_create(here("dmp/output"))

ggsave(
  here("dmp/output/qq_plots.png"),
  qq_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

write_rds(lambda_tbl, here("dmp/output/lambda_table.rds"))

if (needs_bacon) {
  ggsave(
    here("dmp/output/qq_plots_bacon_corrected.png"),
    bacon_qq_plot,
    width = 12,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
  write_rds(lambda_comparison, here("dmp/output/lambda_comparison_bacon.rds"))
}
```

## Summary

```{r}
#| label: summary-table

lambda_tbl |>
  select(demcat, lambda) |>
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      lambda <= 1.0 ~ "No inflation",
      lambda <= 1.1 ~ "Minimal inflation",
      lambda <= 1.2 ~ "Moderate inflation",
      TRUE ~ "Substantial inflation"
    )
  )
```
